full_details: You are not cast today, and the back wanted walking. You went over the Bridge for the first time since May, slowly, and paid a penny at Henslowe's door. The bill was Longshanks, new. You stood in the yard, left of the stage, by a post you could lean on. A fair house, not a great one. It is an English king, the first Edward, and the title is the casting. Alleyn is the tallest man on either bank, and he played every inch of it, in gilded mail. Drums, a pageant, blows given and taken from outside. This king never doubts. He stood under the heavens, the throne that was hung there in June gilt above him, and he filled the house like water in a jug. The yard loved it. On the tables, against the post, you wrote that their king is all is, and yours is all seems, and five weeks. Henslowe was at the stair-foot, eyes on the boxes. Alleyn came out by the tiring-house stair in his own clothes. He asked if you had come to count his inches. You had come to learn them. You came home by the Bridge again, and saved the penny.
one_sentence: You stood in the Rose yard for Longshanks, wrote that their king is all is, and told Alleyn you had come to learn his inches.
title: Went to learn Alleyn's inches
